settings.question: How does tightening the byte cap at 4 Mbps affect the feasible boundary, quality, and actual browser readiness?
settings.selections: Exact enumeration winners on a fixed dataset; one frozen selection per distinct case.
settings.order: Twelve paired rounds, rotated case order with alternating direction in blocks of case-count rounds.
settings.pilot: No instrumentation pilots in this follow-up.
settings.throttle: Chrome CDP Network.emulateNetworkConditions, download/upload Mbps*1000000/8 bytes/s, latency100ms. Shared network emulation, not per-image bandwidth. Deprecated API explicitly used; no fallback.
settings.cache: New context per attempt; HTTP cache disabled/cleared; service workers blocked/bypassed; server no-store. OS/filesystem cache not cleared; startup hash validation warms files.
settings.gallery: All14 visible in viewport: seven columns, two rows, fixed190px image frames. Ascending ID, native eager fetching, async decode, auto priority, no preload/srcset/unused variants. Identical shell/CSS/dimensions.
settings.metrics: Navigation-origin image response completion, all-image decode readiness, FCP, last observed LCP with identity; first-image-start to response/decode spans. Readiness does not prove all pixels painted.
settings.success: Exactly14 selected requests, body bytes match manifest, HTTP200 completed, no cache, correct dimensions, decoded, visible stable layout, paint metrics present. Failures retained.
settings.statistics: Mean SSIM, byte totals, median and quartiles, minimum observed time, paired differences to reference, all failures.
settings.target: 2.5 seconds is the reference payload allowance. It is not a browser deadline.
settings.limits: One batch/machine, localhost HTTP/1.1, headless Chrome with emulated throughput/latency. Separate from older offscreen pilot; no universal or real-world speed claim.

server.implementation: Same Node HTTP/1.1 process throughout, readFile per image, no-store. No server delay or compression.
server.cache_scope: New context per attempt; HTTP cache disabled/cleared; service workers blocked/bypassed; server no-store. OS/filesystem cache not cleared; startup hash validation warms files.

definitions.common_origin: performance.timeOrigin (navigation start). All browser times in milliseconds.
definitions.image_requests_complete_ms: Maximum responseEnd across the 14 selected images, relative to navigation.
definitions.image_request_span_ms: Last image responseEnd minus earliest image startTime. Includes browser queueing and latency.
definitions.image_decode_ready_ms: Latest decode() resolution for all14 images, relative to navigation. decode() called on each load event. Not proof all pixels painted.
definitions.image_readiness_span_ms: All-image decode readiness minus earliest image fetch start.
definitions.lcp_ms: Last largest-contentful-paint entry at cutoff, with element identity saved.
definitions.observation_cutoff: 1000ms after all decode promises settle, or after timeout/error; no scrolling or interaction.
definitions.image_payload_bytes: Sum encodedBodySize; must equal the selected files.
definitions.image_transfer_bytes: Sum ResourceTiming.transferSize; includes browser-reported headers, not physical-link bytes.
definitions.latency: CDP minimum request-to-response-header delay, not measured physical RTT.
definitions.theoretical_transfer_ms: Selected bytes*8/(Mbps*1000000)*1000; estimate excludes latency, competing traffic, non-image bytes and decode.
definitions.solver_runtime_ms_precomputed: No solver timing supplied for precomputed exact-enumeration selections.
definitions.target: Modeled2.5s allowance; navigation/readiness span attainment counted separately.
